units.Habakkuk 1:1: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.
units.Habakkuk 1:2: How long, Lord, shall I cry and Thou wilt not listen? I shall cry to Thee while being wronged, and Thou wilt not save?
units.Habakkuk 1:3: Why didst Thou show me toil and pain, to look upon misery and impiety? Judgment has come against me, and the judge takes.
units.Habakkuk 1:4: Therefore law has been scattered, and judgment is not brought to completion; the impious oppresses the righteous, so judgment will go forth distorted.
units.Habakkuk 1:5: Look, you despisers, observe, marvel at wonders and vanish! For I am doing a work in your days that you will certainly not believe if someone recounts it.
units.Habakkuk 1:6: For look, I am raising up against you the Chaldean warriors, the bitter and swift nation, who traverse the breadth of the earth to possess dwellings not their own.
units.Habakkuk 1:7: Fearsome and conspicuous are they; their judgment will come from themselves, and their claim will proceed from themselves.
units.Habakkuk 1:8: Their horses will leap beyond leopards and be fiercer than the wolves of Arabia. Their horsemen will ride out and rush from afar, flying like an eagle eager to eat.
units.Habakkuk 1:9: An end will come upon the impious who stand facing them in opposition, and they will gather captives like sand.
units.Habakkuk 1:10: They will revel among kings, and tyrants will be their toys; they will mock every fortress, throw up a mound and seize it.
units.Habakkuk 1:11: Then the spirit will change and pass through and make propitiation. This strength belongs to my God.
units.Habakkuk 1:12: Art Thou not from the beginning, Lord, my holy God? We shall certainly not die. Lord, Thou hast appointed him for judgment, and He formed me to reprove his discipline.
units.Habakkuk 1:13: Thine eye is pure, not to see evil things, and Thou wilt not be able to look upon distress. Why dost Thou look upon despisers? Wilt Thou remain silent when the impious swallows the righteous?
units.Habakkuk 1:14: Thou wilt make people like the fish of the sea and like creeping things with no leader.
units.Habakkuk 1:15: They hauled up an entire catch with a hook, dragged it in a casting net and gathered it in their seines; therefore they will rejoice and their heart will be glad.
units.Habakkuk 1:16: Therefore they will sacrifice to their seine and burn incense to their casting net, for through them they fattened their portion, and their foods are choice.
units.Habakkuk 1:17: Therefore they will cast their casting net and will not spare nations from continual killing.
units.Habakkuk 2:1: I will stand at my watch and step onto a rock; I will look out to see what He will speak within me and what I shall answer concerning my reproof.
units.Habakkuk 2:2: The Lord answered me: “Write a vision clearly on a boxwood tablet, so that the one reading these things may pursue them.
units.Habakkuk 2:3: For the vision is still for a season, and it will rise toward the end and not toward emptiness. If he delays, wait for him, for coming he will come and certainly will not linger.
units.Habakkuk 2:4: If he draws back, My soul has no pleasure in him; but the righteous one shall live by My faithfulness.
units.Habakkuk 2:5: But the wine-soaked, contemptuous, boastful man will accomplish nothing. He widened his appetite like Hades and is like death, never filled; he will gather all nations and receive all peoples to himself.
units.Habakkuk 2:6: Will not all these take up a parable against him and a riddle for his account? They will say, ‘Woe to the one multiplying for himself what is not his—how long?—and heavily weighting his collar!’
units.Habakkuk 2:7: For suddenly those biting him will rise, and those plotting against you will awake; you will become their plunder.
units.Habakkuk 2:8: Because you despoiled many nations, all the remaining peoples will despoil you, because of human bloodshed and impiety against land, city and all its inhabitants.
units.Habakkuk 2:9: O you who acquire evil gain for your house, setting your nest on high to escape the hand of evils!
units.Habakkuk 2:10: You planned shame for your house, brought many peoples to an end, and your soul sinned.
units.Habakkuk 2:11: For a stone will cry from a wall, and a beetle from wood will utter these things.
units.Habakkuk 2:12: Woe to the one building a city with bloodshed and preparing a city with injustices!
units.Habakkuk 2:13: Are these things not from the Lord Almighty? Many peoples failed in fire, and many nations lost heart.
units.Habakkuk 2:14: For the earth will be filled with knowing the Lord’s glory, as water will cover them.
units.Habakkuk 2:15: O you who make your neighbor drink with a turbid overthrow and intoxicate him, so that you may look upon their caves!
units.Habakkuk 2:16: Drink, you too, a fullness of dishonor instead of glory; be tossed and shaken! The cup of the Lord’s right hand has come around to you, and dishonor has gathered upon your glory.
units.Habakkuk 2:17: For Lebanon’s impiety will cover you, and the misery of wild animals will terrify you, because of human bloodshed and impiety against land, city and all its inhabitants.
units.Habakkuk 2:18: What use is a carved image, that they carved it? They formed it as a cast object, a false appearance, because its maker trusted his creation, making mute idols.
units.Habakkuk 2:19: Woe to the one saying to wood, ‘Wake and rise!’ and to stone, ‘Be lifted up!’ It is an appearance, a plate of gold and silver, and no breath at all is in it.
units.Habakkuk 2:20: But the Lord is in His holy sanctuary; let all the earth revere Him.”
units.Habakkuk 3:1: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, with a song.
units.Habakkuk 3:2: Lord, I have heard Thy report and was afraid; I considered Thy works and was astonished. In the midst of two living creatures Thou wilt be known; when the years draw near Thou wilt be recognized; when the season arrives Thou wilt be revealed. When my soul is troubled, in wrath Thou wilt remember mercy.
units.Habakkuk 3:3: God will come from Teman, the Holy One from a mountain shaded and thickly wooded. Diapsalma. His excellence covered the heavens, and the earth is full of His praise.
units.Habakkuk 3:4: His brightness will be like light; horns are in His hands, and He established mighty love of His strength.
units.Habakkuk 3:5: A word will go before Him, and He will go out, His feet in sandals.
units.Habakkuk 3:6: He stood, and the earth shook; He looked, and nations melted. Mountains were crushed violently; everlasting hills melted.
units.Habakkuk 3:7: I saw His everlasting journeys in place of toils; the dwellings of Ethiopians will be terrified, and the tents of the land of Midian.
units.Habakkuk 3:8: Wast Thou angry with rivers, Lord? Was Thy fury against rivers, or Thine onrush against the sea, that Thou wilt mount Thy horses and Thy riding is salvation?
units.Habakkuk 3:9: Thou wilt surely bend Thy bow against scepters, says the Lord. Diapsalma. The earth will be torn apart by rivers.
units.Habakkuk 3:10: Peoples will see Thee and travail, as He scatters waters in His passage. The abyss gave its voice, the height of its appearance.
units.Habakkuk 3:11: The sun was raised, and the moon stood in its appointed place. Thy missiles will go into light, into the brightness of Thy flashing weapons.
units.Habakkuk 3:12: With threat Thou wilt diminish the earth, and in fury Thou wilt bring nations down.
units.Habakkuk 3:13: Thou didst go out for Thy people’s salvation, to save Thine anointed ones. Thou didst cast death upon the heads of lawless people and didst raise bonds up to the neck. Diapsalma.
units.Habakkuk 3:14: Thou didst cut the heads of rulers in bewilderment; they will be shaken in it. They will open their bridles like a poor person eating secretly.
units.Habakkuk 3:15: Thou didst drive Thy horses into the sea as they troubled much water.
units.Habakkuk 3:16: I kept watch, and my belly was terrified at the sound of the prayer of my lips. Trembling entered my bones, and my bodily condition beneath me was troubled. I will rest on a day of affliction, to go up to the people of my sojourning.
units.Habakkuk 3:17: For the fig tree will not bear fruit, and vines will have no produce; the olive’s labor will fail, and fields will not produce food. Sheep have failed for lack of food, and there are no cattle at feeding troughs.
units.Habakkuk 3:18: But I will exult in the Lord; I will rejoice in God my Savior.
units.Habakkuk 3:19: The Lord God is my strength; He will set my feet toward completion and lead me onto the heights, to conquer in His song.
units.Psalms 12:1: For the end. A psalm of David.
units.Psalms 12:2: How long, Lord, wilt Thou forget me utterly? How long wilt Thou turn Thy face away from me?
units.Psalms 12:3: How long shall I place counsels within my soul, pains within my heart by day? How long will my enemy be raised above me?
units.Psalms 12:4: Look; hear me, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I fall asleep into death,
units.Psalms 12:5: lest my enemy say, “I prevailed against him.” Those who afflict me will exult if I am shaken.
units.Psalms 12:6: But I have hoped in Thy mercy; my heart will exult in Thy salvation. I will sing to the Lord, who has benefited me, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
units.Job 19:6: Know, then, that the Lord is the One who disturbed me and raised His stronghold against me.
units.Job 19:7: Behold, I laugh in reproach and will not speak; I will cry out, but judgment is nowhere.
units.Job 19:8: I have been walled in all around and cannot pass through; He placed darkness before my face.
units.Isaiah 59:12: For our lawlessness is great before Thee, and our sins have opposed us. Our lawless deeds are within us, and we have recognized our wrongs:
units.Isaiah 59:13: We acted impiously and lied and withdrew from following our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed; we conceived and meditated on unjust words from our heart.
units.Isaiah 59:14: We drove judgment backward, and righteousness has withdrawn far away, for truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not go straight through.
units.Isaiah 59:15: Truth has been taken away, and they turned their mind away from understanding. The Lord saw, and it did not please Him that there was no judgment.
units.Acts 13:38: Therefore let it be known to you, men, brothers, that through Him forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you; and from everything from which you could not be justified in the law of Moses,
units.Acts 13:39: in Him everyone who believes is justified.
units.Acts 13:40: Take care, then, lest what is spoken in the prophets come upon you:
units.Acts 13:41: ‘Look, you scoffers, marvel and vanish, for I am doing a work in your days, a work you will never believe even if someone recounts it to you.’”
units.Jeremiah 5:15: Behold, I am bringing a nation upon you from far away, house of Israel, says the Lord, a nation whose language’s sound you will not understand.
units.Jeremiah 5:17: and they will devour your harvest and your bread, and devour your sons and daughters, and devour your sheep and calves, and devour your vineyards and fig orchards and olive groves; and with a sword they will thresh your fortified cities, in which you have trusted.
units.Isaiah 10:5: Woe to the Assyrians! The rod of My anger and wrath is in their hands.
units.Isaiah 10:6: I will send My anger against a lawless nation, and I will command My people to take spoils and plunder, trample the cities and reduce them to dust.
units.Isaiah 10:7: But he did not consider it this way and has not reckoned it this way in his soul; rather, his mind will turn aside, even to destroy not a few nations.
units.Isaiah 10:8: If they say to him, “You alone are ruler,”
units.Isaiah 10:9: he will say, “Did I not take the country above Babylon and Chalanneh, where the tower was built? I also took Arabia, Damascus and Samaria.
units.Isaiah 10:10: As I took these in my hand, I will also take all the dominions. Wail, carved images in Jerusalem and Samaria!
units.Isaiah 10:11: For as I did to Samaria and her handmade objects, so I will also do to Jerusalem and her idols.”
units.Isaiah 10:12: When the Lord has finished doing all things on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, He will bring judgment upon the great mind—the ruler of the Assyrians—and upon the height of the glory of his eyes.
units.Isaiah 10:13: For he said, “By strength I will act, and by the wisdom of understanding. I will remove nations’ boundaries, plunder their strength and shake inhabited cities.
units.Isaiah 10:14: I will seize the whole inhabited world in my hand like a nest, and lift it like abandoned eggs. There is no one who will escape me or contradict me.”
units.Deuteronomy 28:49: The Lord shall bring against you a nation from afar, from the end of the earth, as the swooping of an eagle, a nation whose speech you shall not understand,
units.Deuteronomy 28:50: a nation shameless of countenance, which shall not regard the face of the aged, nor have mercy upon the young.
units.Deuteronomy 28:51: And it shall consume the offspring of your cattle and the produce of your land, leaving you neither grain, nor wine, nor oil, nor the herds of your cattle, nor the flocks of your sheep, until it destroys you.
units.Deuteronomy 28:52: And it shall wear you down in all your cities, until your high and fortified walls wherein you trust are cast down throughout all your land; and it shall afflict you in all your cities which the Lord your God has given you.
units.2 Kings 24:10: At that time Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city came under siege.
units.2 Kings 24:11: Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon entered the city while his servants were besieging it.
units.2 Kings 24:12: Joakim king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, his servants, his mother, his rulers, and his eunuchs. The king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
units.2 Kings 24:13: He brought out from there all the treasures of the Lord’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He cut apart all the gold vessels Solomon king of Israel had made in the Lord’s sanctuary, according to the Lord’s word.
units.2 Kings 24:14: He deported Jerusalem, all the rulers, and the mighty in strength, taking ten thousand captives, and every craftsman and one who shuts up. None remained except the land’s poor.
units.2 Kings 24:15: He deported Joakim to Babylon, along with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, and his eunuchs. He led the land’s powerful men into deportation from Jerusalem to Babylon,
units.2 Kings 24:16: and all the men of the force, seven thousand, and the craftsmen and those who shut up, one thousand—all mighty men who waged war. The king of Babylon brought them into deportation to Babylon.
units.Ezekiel 26:7: For thus says the Lord: I am bringing against you, Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north—he is king of kings—with horses, chariots, horsemen, and an assembly of very many nations.
units.Ezekiel 26:8: He will kill your daughters in the plain with the sword, set an advance guard against you, build around you, and make a palisade and a ring of weapons around you; he will set his spears opposite you.
units.Ezekiel 26:9: He will throw down your walls and your towers with his swords.
units.Psalms 72:1: A psalm of Asaph. How good God is to Israel, to those upright in heart!
units.Psalms 72:2: But my feet were almost shaken; my steps were nearly poured out.
units.Psalms 72:3: For I envied the lawless, beholding sinners’ peace,
units.Psalms 72:4: for there is no refusal at their death, and firmness in their scourging.
units.Psalms 72:5: They are not in human toils, and they will not be scourged with humans.
units.Psalms 72:6: Therefore arrogance seized them; they wrapped themselves in their injustice and ungodliness.
units.Psalms 72:7: Their injustice will come out as though from fat; they passed into a disposition of heart.
units.Psalms 72:8: They devised and spoke in wickedness; they spoke injustice against the height.
units.Psalms 72:9: They set their mouth toward heaven, and their tongue passed over the earth.
units.Psalms 72:10: Therefore my people will return here, and full days will be found for them.
units.Psalms 72:11: And they said, “How did God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?”
units.Psalms 72:12: Behold, these are sinners, and they prosper; for the age they took possession of wealth.
units.Psalms 72:13: And I said, “Then in vain I made my heart righteous and washed my hands among the innocent;
units.Psalms 72:14: and I became scourged all day, and my rebuke comes in the mornings.”
units.Ecclesiastes 9:11: Again I saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor battle to the mighty, nor bread to the wise, nor wealth to those with understanding, nor favor to those with knowledge; for time and encounter will happen to them all.
units.Ecclesiastes 9:12: For a person does not know his time: like fish caught in an evil net, and birds caught in a snare, so human beings are trapped at an evil time when it falls upon them suddenly.
units.Jeremiah 16:14: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, ‘The Lord lives, who brought Israel’s sons up from Egypt’s land,’
units.Jeremiah 16:15: but, ‘The Lord lives, who brought Israel’s house up from the northern land and all the regions where they were driven.’ And I will restore them to their land that I gave their fathers.
units.Jeremiah 16:16: Behold, I am sending the many fishermen, says the Lord, and they will fish for them; and after these things I will send the many hunters, and they will hunt them on every mountain and hill and from the rocks’ openings.
units.Jeremiah 16:17: Because My eyes are upon all their ways, and their wrongdoings were not hidden before My eyes.
units.Jeremiah 16:18: And I will repay double their injustices and sins, for which they profaned My land with the corpses of their abominations and with their lawless acts, by which they offended against My inheritance.
units.Ecclesiastes 3:16: Again I saw beneath the sun: in the place of judgment, the ungodly person was there; in the righteous person’s place, the ungodly person was there.
units.Ecclesiastes 3:17: I said in my heart: God will judge the righteous and the ungodly, for there is a time for every matter and for every work.
units.Isaiah 44:9: All who fashion and carve are futile, making what pleases them, things that will not help them. But they will be ashamed—
units.Isaiah 44:10: all who fashion a god and carve useless things,
units.Isaiah 44:11: and all from whom they came have dried up. Let the deaf from among humankind all assemble and stand together; let them be abashed and ashamed together.
units.Isaiah 44:12: For a craftsman sharpened iron, worked it with an adze, bored it with a drill, and worked it with his strong arm. He will hunger and grow weak and certainly not drink water. Having selected
units.Isaiah 44:13: wood, a craftsman set it by measure and arranged it with glue. He made it like a man’s form and human beauty, to set it in a house.
units.Isaiah 44:14: The wood he cut from the woodland was what the Lord planted and rain made grow,
units.Isaiah 44:15: so that it might serve people for burning. Taking some, he warmed himself; after burning it they baked loaves over the pieces. They worked the rest into gods and worship them.
units.Isaiah 44:16: Half of it they burned in fire, and after burning it they baked loaves over the pieces. Over it he roasted meat, ate, and was satisfied. Warmed, he said, ‘It is pleasant for me, for I am warm and have seen fire!’
units.Isaiah 44:17: He made the rest into a carved god and worships it and prays, saying, ‘Rescue me, for you are my god.’
units.Isaiah 44:18: They did not know enough to understand, because they were darkened from seeing with their eyes and comprehending with their heart.
units.Isaiah 44:19: He did not reckon it in his heart, consider it in his soul, or know by understanding that he burned half in fire, baked loaves over its coals, roasted meat and ate, and made its remainder an abomination; and they worship it.
units.Isaiah 44:20: Know that their heart is ashes, and they wander, and no one can rescue his soul. See—will you not say, ‘A lie is in my right hand’?
units.Isaiah 21:6: For thus the Lord said to me: “Go, station a watcher for yourself, and report whatever you see.
units.Isaiah 21:7: I saw mounted riders, two horsemen, a donkey rider and a camel rider. Listen with great attention,
units.Isaiah 21:8: and call Uriah to the Lord’s watchtower.” He said, “I stood continually by day, and at the camp I stood all night,
units.Isaiah 21:9: and behold, he himself comes, a rider of a two-horse team.” He answered and said, “Babylon has fallen, and all her statues and handmade objects were shattered to the ground.”
units.Isaiah 21:10: Hear, you who remain and suffer; hear what I heard from the Lord Sabaoth. Israel’s God announced it to us.
units.Isaiah 30:8: Now then, sit and write these things on a tablet and in a book, because these things will endure for days of appointed times and for ever.
units.Isaiah 30:9: For this is a disobedient people, lying sons who did not want to hear God’s law,
units.Isaiah 30:10: who say to the prophets, “Do not announce to us,” and to those seeing visions, “Do not speak to us. Instead, speak to us and announce another deception,
units.Isaiah 30:11: and turn us from this way, remove this path from us, and remove Israel’s Holy One from us.”
units.Hebrews 10:35: Therefore do not throw away your confidence, which has a great reward.
units.Hebrews 10:36: For you need endurance, so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
units.Hebrews 10:37: “For yet a very little while, the coming One will come and will not delay.
units.Hebrews 10:38: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he draws back, My soul takes no pleasure in him.”
units.Hebrews 10:39: But we are not people who draw back to destruction, but people of faith for the preservation of the soul.
units.Romans 1:16: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is God’s power for salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
units.Romans 1:17: For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith, as it is written, “But the righteous one will live by faith.”
units.Galatians 3:10: For all who are of works of law are under a curse, for it is written, “Accursed is everyone who does not abide by all the things written in the book of the law, to do them.”
units.Galatians 3:11: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by law, because “The righteous one will live by faith.”
units.Galatians 3:12: But the law is not of faith; rather, “The one who does these things will live by them.”
units.Proverbs 27:20: Hades and destruction are not filled, and likewise human eyes are insatiable.
units.Isaiah 14:3: On that day God will give you rest from pain, your wrath and the harsh slavery in which you served them,
units.Isaiah 14:4: and you will take up this lament against Babylon’s king and say on that day, “How the one who made demands has rested, and the taskmaster rested!
units.Isaiah 14:5: God shattered the sinners’ yoke, the rulers’ yoke;
units.Isaiah 14:6: having struck a nation in wrath with an incurable blow, striking a nation with a blow of anger that did not spare,
units.Isaiah 14:7: he rested confidently. The whole earth cries out with gladness,
units.Isaiah 14:8: and Lebanon’s trees rejoiced over you, and Lebanon’s cedar: ‘Since you have fallen asleep, the one cutting us has not come up.’
units.Isaiah 33:1: Woe to those afflicting you—yet no one afflicts you—and the one rejecting you does not reject. The rejecters will be captured and handed over; like a moth upon a cloak, so they will be defeated.
units.Isaiah 33:2: Lord, have mercy on us, for we have trusted in Thee. The disobedient people’s seed came to destruction, but our salvation is in a time of affliction.
units.Isaiah 33:3: At the sound of Thy terror, peoples were dismayed by fear of Thee, and nations scattered.
units.Isaiah 33:4: Now your spoils, small and great, will be gathered; as someone gathers locusts, so they will mock you.
units.Obadiah 1:3: The pride of your heart has lifted you up, you who camp in holes in the rocks, raising his dwelling high and saying in his heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”
units.Obadiah 1:4: If you soar like an eagle, and if you place your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord.
units.Obadiah 1:15: For the day of the Lord is near against all the nations. Just as you acted, so it will be for you; your recompense will be repaid upon your own head.
units.Obadiah 1:16: For just as you drank on My holy mountain, all the nations will drink wine; they will drink and go down, and they will be as though they did not exist.
units.Jeremiah 22:13: O you who build your house without righteousness and your upper rooms without judgment! He works through his neighbor without payment and will not give him his wages.
units.Jeremiah 22:14: You built yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms set apart by windows, paneled with cedar and painted with red ocher.
units.Jeremiah 22:15: Will you reign because you are provoked in Ahaz your father? They will not eat or drink. It was better for you to do judgment and good righteousness.
units.Jeremiah 22:16: They did not know; they did not judge a case for the lowly or a case for the poor. Is this not your failing to know Me? says the Lord.
units.Jeremiah 22:17: Behold, neither your eyes nor your heart are good; instead they are directed toward your greed, innocent blood to shed it, wrongdoing, and murder to commit it.
units.Luke 19:37: As He was already drawing near the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen,
units.Luke 19:38: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
units.Luke 19:39: And some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, rebuke Thy disciples.”
units.Luke 19:40: And He answered, “I tell you, if these fall silent, the stones will cry out.”
units.Micah 3:9: Hear these things now, leaders of Jacob’s house and remaining ones of Israel’s house, who abhor justice and twist all straight things,
units.Micah 3:10: you who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with injustices!
units.Micah 3:11: Her leaders judged with gifts, her priests answered for wages and her prophets divined for silver; yet they relied upon the Lord, saying, “Is not the Lord among us? Calamities will certainly not come upon us.”
units.Micah 3:12: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will be like a fruit watcher’s hut, and the mountain of the house like a forest grove.
units.Jeremiah 28:57: He will make her leaders and wise men and generals thoroughly drunk, says the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.
units.Jeremiah 28:58: Thus says the Lord: Babylon’s wall was broadened; it will be utterly demolished, and her high gates burned. Peoples will not labor in vain, and nations will perish at the beginning.
units.Isaiah 11:6: And the wolf will feed with the lamb, and the leopard will rest with the young goat; and the calf and the bull and the lion will feed together, and a little child will lead them.
units.Isaiah 11:7: And the ox and the bear will feed together, and their young will be together; and the lion and the ox will eat straw together.
units.Isaiah 11:8: And an infant will stretch out his hand over the hole of asps, and over the nest of their young.
units.Isaiah 11:9: And they will certainly do no harm, nor will they be able at all to destroy anyone upon My holy mountain; for the whole earth has been filled with the knowledge of the Lord, as abundant water covers the seas.
units.Genesis 9:20: And Noah began to till the ground, and planted a vineyard.
units.Genesis 9:21: And he drank of the wine and became drunk, and lay uncovered in his house.
units.Genesis 9:22: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness, and went out and told his two brothers outside.
units.Genesis 9:23: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, laid it across their shoulders, and walked backward to cover their father’s nakedness. Their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father’s nakedness.
units.Genesis 9:24: And Noah awoke from his wine and knew what his younger son had done to him.
units.Isaiah 51:17: Awake, awake, rise, Jerusalem, you who drank the cup of anger from the Lord’s hand. You drank out and emptied the cup of falling, the bowl of anger.
units.Isaiah 51:18: There was no one to comfort you among all your children you bore, and no one to take your hand among all your sons you raised.
units.Isaiah 51:19: These two confront you—who will grieve with you?—fall and crushing, famine and sword. Who will comfort you?
units.Isaiah 51:20: Your sons are helpless, sleeping at every way out like a half-boiled beet, full of the Lord’s anger, exhausted because of the Lord God.
units.Isaiah 51:21: Therefore listen, humbled one, drunk but not from wine.
units.Isaiah 51:22: Thus says the Lord God who judges His people: ‘Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of falling, the bowl of anger. You will not drink it again.
units.Isaiah 51:23: I will throw it into the hands of those who wronged and humbled you, who told your soul, “Bend down, so we may pass.” You laid your back level with the earth, outside for passersby.’”
units.Jeremiah 10:1: Hear the Lord’s word that He spoke concerning you, house of Israel.
units.Jeremiah 10:2: Thus says the Lord: Do not learn according to the nations’ ways, and do not fear heaven’s signs, because they fear them before their faces.
units.Jeremiah 10:3: For the nations’ customs are futile: it is wood cut from the woodland, a carpenter’s work and a cast object.
units.Jeremiah 10:4: They are adorned with silver and gold; with hammers and nails they fastened them, and they will not move.
units.Jeremiah 10:5: They must be lifted and carried, because they will not take a step. Do not fear them, because they certainly will not do evil, and no good is in them.
units.Jeremiah 10:9: It is worked silver; they will not walk. Applied silver will come from Tarshish, gold from Mophaz, and the goldsmiths’ hand; all are artisans’ works. They will dress them in blue and purple.
units.Jeremiah 10:11: This is what you will say to them: Gods who did not make heaven and earth, let them perish from the earth and from beneath this heaven.
units.Jeremiah 10:12: The Lord who made the earth by His strength, who set the inhabited world upright by His wisdom, also stretched out heaven by His understanding,
units.Jeremiah 10:13: and an abundance of water in heaven; and He brought clouds up from the earth’s extremity, made lightning for rain, and brought light out of His treasuries.
units.Jeremiah 10:14: Every human became foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith was put to shame at his carved things, because they cast false things; there is no spirit in them.
units.Jeremiah 10:15: They are futile, mocked works; at the time of their visitation they will perish.
units.Jeremiah 10:16: Jacob’s portion is not such as this, because the One who formed everything is himself his inheritance; Lord is His name.
units.Psalms 10:4: The Lord is in His holy temple; the Lord’s throne is in heaven. His eyes look toward the needy; His eyelids examine the sons of men.
units.Psalms 10:5: The Lord examines the righteous and the ungodly; but the one who loves injustice hates his own soul.
units.Psalms 10:6: He will rain traps upon sinners; fire, sulfur, and a storm wind are the portion of their cup.
units.Psalms 10:7: For the Lord is righteous and loved righteous deeds; His face beheld uprightness.
units.Zephaniah 1:7: Revere the Lord God, for the Lord’s day is near. The Lord has prepared His sacrifice and consecrated His invited guests.
units.Psalms 76:8: “Will the Lord reject for the ages, and not again take pleasure?
units.Psalms 76:9: Or will He cut off His mercy to the end, from generation to generation?
units.Psalms 76:10: Or will God forget to show pity, or hold His compassions shut in His wrath?” Diapsalma.
units.Psalms 76:11: And I said, “Now I have begun; this is the change of the Most High’s right hand.”
units.Psalms 76:12: I remembered the Lord’s works, for I will remember Thy wonders from the beginning,
units.Psalms 76:13: and meditate on all Thy works, and speak at length about Thy practices.
units.Psalms 76:14: God, Thy way is in the Holy One; what god is great like our God?
units.Psalms 76:15: Thou art the God who does wonders; Thou madest Thy power known among the peoples.
units.Psalms 76:16: With Thine arm Thou didst redeem Thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Diapsalma.
units.Psalms 76:17: The waters saw Thee, God; the waters saw Thee and feared, and the depths were troubled—a multitude of sounding waters.
units.Psalms 76:18: The clouds gave voice, for Thine arrows too pass through.
units.Psalms 76:19: Thy thunder’s voice was in the wheel; Thy flashes of lightning shone upon the inhabited world; the earth shook and became trembling.
units.Psalms 76:20: Thy way is in the sea, and Thy paths in many waters, and Thy tracks will not be known.

units.Ezekiel 1:26: Like the appearance of a sapphire stone was the likeness of a throne upon it; and above the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the form of a human being.
units.Ezekiel 1:27: I saw something like the sight of electrum from the appearance of a waist upward; and from the appearance of a waist down below I saw something like the appearance of fire, with its brightness all around.
units.Ezekiel 1:28: Like the appearance of a bow when it is in the cloud on a rainy day, so was the arrangement of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the Lord’s glory. I saw it, and I fall upon my face, and I heard the voice of One speaking.
units.Nahum 1:5: Mountains shook before Him and hills were shaken; the whole earth recoiled before Him, and all who dwell in it.
units.Nahum 1:6: Who will stand before His anger? Who will resist His furious wrath? His fury melts rulers, and rocks were crushed before Him.
units.Judges 7:19: Gideon and the hundred men with him entered a section of the camp as the middle watch began. He thoroughly roused the guards, and they sounded the horn trumpets and dashed the jars in their hands.
units.Judges 7:20: The three companies sounded the horn trumpets and shattered the jars. They grasped the torches in their left hands, with the horn trumpets in their right hands to sound them, and cried, “A sword for the Lord and for Gideon!”
units.Judges 7:21: Each stood by himself around the camp. The whole camp ran; they sounded the alarm and fled.
units.Judges 7:22: The three hundred horn trumpets sounded, and the Lord set each man’s sword against his neighbour throughout the camp. The camp fled as far as Beth-shittah and, gathered together, as far as the edge of Abel-meholah and toward Tabbath.
units.Psalms 7:12: God is a righteous judge, strong and patient, not bringing wrath every day.
units.Psalms 7:13: If you do not return, He will polish His sword; He bent His bow and prepared it,
units.Psalms 7:14: and in it He prepared instruments of death; He fashioned His arrows for those being burned.
units.Joshua 10:12: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord on the day God handed the Amorites over to Israel, when He crushed them at Gibeon and they were crushed before the sons of Israel. Joshua said, “Let the sun stand over Gibeon, and the moon over the ravine of Aijalon.”
units.Joshua 10:13: The sun stood, and the moon remained still, until God repelled their enemies. The sun stood in the middle of heaven and did not advance toward sunset for a full day.
units.Joshua 10:14: There was no such day before or afterward, when God listened to a human being, for the Lord fought alongside Israel.
units.Isaiah 34:1: Draw near, nations, and hear, rulers! Let the earth and those in it hear, the inhabited world and the people in it!
units.Isaiah 34:2: For the Lord’s wrath is against all nations, and anger against their number, to destroy them and hand them over to slaughter.
units.Isaiah 34:3: Their wounded and dead will be thrown out; their odor will rise, and mountains will be soaked with their blood.
units.Isaiah 34:4: Heaven will roll up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine, like leaves falling from a fig tree.
units.Psalms 17:50: Therefore I will thank Thee among the nations, Lord, and sing praise to Thy name,
units.Psalms 17:51: magnifying the salvations of His king and showing mercy to His anointed, to David and to his seed for ever.
units.Daniel 10:7: I, Daniel, saw this great vision, but the men with me did not see it. Strong fear fell upon them, and they fled in haste.
units.Daniel 10:8: I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; a spirit turned upon me for destruction, and I had no strength.
units.Daniel 10:9: I did not hear the sound of his speech; I had fallen face down upon the earth.
units.Joel 1:10: because the plains have suffered. Let the earth mourn, because grain has suffered, wine has dried up, and oil has diminished.
units.Joel 1:11: The farmers have dried up. Lament, estates, over wheat and barley, because the harvest from the field has perished.
units.Joel 1:12: The vine has dried up and the fig trees have diminished; pomegranate, palm, apple tree and all the field’s trees have dried up, because human beings have put joy to shame.
units.Joel 1:18: What shall we store up for ourselves? Herds of cattle wept because they had no pasture, and flocks of sheep disappeared.
units.Joel 1:19: To Thee, Lord, I will cry, because fire consumed the beautiful places of the wilderness, and flame kindled all the field’s trees.
units.Joel 1:20: Even the animals of the plain looked up toward Thee, because outlets of water dried up, and fire devoured the beautiful places of the wilderness.

units.Luke 1:47: and my spirit rejoiced in God my Savior,
units.Luke 1:48: because He looked upon the lowly condition of His servant. For behold, from now on all generations will call me blessed,
units.Luke 1:49: because the Mighty One has done great things for me, and holy is His name.
units.Psalms 17:32: For who is God except the Lord? And who is God except our God?
units.Psalms 17:33: God girds me with power and made my way blameless,
units.Psalms 17:34: He sets my feet firmly like a deer’s and makes me stand upon the heights,
units.Psalms 17:35: training my hands for war; and Thou madest my arms a bronze bow.
units.Judges 7:12: Midian, Amalek, and all the sons of the east were encamped in the valley like locusts in multitude. Their camels were beyond numbering, like sand on the seashore in multitude.
units.Judges 7:13: Gideon entered, and look, a man was explaining his dream to his neighbour. He said, “Look at the dream I dreamed: a cake of barley bread was rolling through Midian’s camp. It came to Midian’s tent, struck it, and overturned it, and the tent fell.”
units.Judges 7:14: His neighbour answered, “This is nothing but the sword of Gideon son of Joash, a man of Israel. The Lord has given Midian and the whole camp into his hand.”
units.Judges 7:15: When Gideon heard the dream’s account and its interpretation, he worshiped the Lord. He returned to Israel’s camp and said, “Arise, for the Lord has given Midian’s camp into your hands.”
units.Judges 7:16: He divided the three hundred men into three companies and put horn trumpets into all their hands, and empty water jars with torches inside the jars.
units.Judges 7:17: He said to them, “Look at me and do likewise. Behold, I enter the midst of the camp; as I do, so shall you do.
units.Judges 7:18: When I and all who are with me sound the horn trumpet, you also shall sound the horn trumpets all around the camp and say, ‘For the Lord and for Gideon!’”
units.Psalms 27:6: Blessed be the Lord, because He heard the voice of my petition.
units.Psalms 27:7: The Lord is my helper and my protector; in Him my heart hoped, and I was helped, and my flesh blossomed anew; from my own will I will thank Him.
units.Psalms 27:8: The Lord is the stronghold of His people and the protector of the salvations of His anointed.
units.Psalms 27:9: Save Thy people and bless Thine inheritance; shepherd them and lift them up for ever.
units.Luke 19:28: And after saying these things, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
units.Luke 19:29: And it happened that as He drew near Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called Olivet, He sent two of the disciples,
units.Luke 19:30: saying, “Go into the village opposite. As you enter it, you will find a colt tied, on which no person has ever sat. Untie it and bring it.
units.Luke 19:31: And if anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ you shall say this: ‘The Lord has need of it.’”
units.Luke 19:32: Those who were sent went away and found it just as He had told them.
units.Luke 19:33: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
units.Luke 19:34: And they said, “The Lord has need of it.”
units.Luke 19:35: They brought it to Jesus, threw their garments on the colt, and set Jesus upon it.
units.Luke 19:36: As He went, they spread their own garments on the road.
